title: Inspect the credential reservation
purpose: Read the selected device credential storage without changing it.
prerequisites: Select a provisioned device with matching article revision and original server-verified public-key evidence.
Use a reviewed compatible LINK or CORE image in application mode and a writable private evidence store. Physical inspection and installation require separate authorization.

steps.action: Select the device and compatible image.
steps.expected: The selected role, device and exact build match the guide.
evidence: Operator, selected registry device and article revision
Role, source and expected firmware artifact SHA-256

steps.expected: The attempt and exact guide and build bindings are durable before USB access.
evidence: Local attempt ID, UTC start time and durable save result
Exact definition, runner, Workshop build and firmware digests

steps.action: Connect the selected board in application mode.
steps.expected: The operator acknowledges the cable connection.
evidence: Operator cable connection acknowledgement or cancellation

steps.action: Verify a fresh signed identity proof, then inspect the reservation.
steps.expected: A fresh proof and response match the selected identity, boot, build and request. The result reports the classification and SHA-256 of exactly 8,192 bytes. Recognizable markers are not verified credentials. No write occurs.
evidence: Fresh signature verification and bound device, public key, role, source and boot
Request ID, inspection classification and SHA-256 of all 8,192 bytes
Bounded runner result or explicit error

steps.action: Record the displayed classification or why it was unavailable.
steps.expected: The observation matches the result or remains incomplete.
evidence: Operator and observed classification or reason unavailable

steps.expected: All automatic results, observations and exact bindings survive reopening.
evidence: Reopened local report ID and snapshot checksum

steps.expected: The export is recorded and the private local attempt is retained.
evidence: Operator, export outcome and exported report digest or error

rules.pass: Every automatic check and required observation succeeds with matching bindings, a reopened local report and export evidence. This does not prove preparation, credential installation or lifecycle readiness.
rules.fail: Malformed, changed, failed or mismatched identity, storage or observation stops the attempt.
rules.blocked: Missing verified identity evidence, compatible build or unambiguous target blocks the attempt.
rules.incomplete: Cancellation, missing observations or interruption remain explicit; retries are new linked attempts.
